notes.title: Beta V1.9.1
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Bugfix: AI drew from discard pile when not allowed
[*] Added cards to other players' melds no longer count towards first meld minimum points
[*] Various bugfixes (e.g. replacing jokers, placing cards in different positions)
[*] AI is now multithreaded
[*] Other fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Beta Playtest V1.8.0 for Major Update
notes.content:
*** NEW RULE VARIANTS ****
Initial meld can be made with multiple sets & runs
Joker number adjustable
Deck cards adjustable, e.g., mini deck with 32 cards
Number of decks adjustable
Options for minimum initial meld points: 45 and 50, other
Option when cards can be added to other players’ melds
Settings to require that the initial meld must include a sequence
Variants where in the first round, drawing can only be done from the stock pile

*** BUGFIXES ***
Fix: Joker can also be placed at the bottom of runs

*** NEW FEATURES ***
2 large card designs available, card ranks are bigger and easier to see (e.g., for Steam Deck)
Ultrawide screen resolutions supported (up to aspect ratio 2.5:1)
